items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Trending toward game-time call Thursday
items.text:
Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Wednesday that Tuten (ankle/foot) is feeling better, but the running back's status for Thursday's contest versus the Ravens is expected to come down to a game-time decision, John Shipley of SI.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Shedeur Sanders: Could start Week 9 with Watson in protocol
items.text:
Sanders could be needed to start Sunday's game at New Orleans after Deshaun Watson was placed in concussion protocol when he experienced symptoms Monday, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Placed in concussion protocol
items.text:

items.text:

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Reportedly out for season with turf toe
items.text:
Huntley (toe) has reportedly sustained a season-ending turf toe injury, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
